title: lore path/export/graph never see Quest's dependency edges (parent-only projection)
description:
Fixture: parent PGF-1, prerequisite PGF-2, dependent PGF-3. Quest correctly reports PGF-3.dependencies=[PGF-2] and its readiness filter correctly excludes PGF-3 until PGF-2 completes -- parenthood alone does not gate readiness.

But 'lore path PGF-3 PGF-2 --from-kind task --to-kind task --direction outbound --json' returns paths=[], shown=0, complete=true, and 'lore export' emits parentTaskId with no dependencies field at all. Story-to-task coupling paths do work. 'lore graph' exposes concept links only, not this combined graph.

Proposed: export dependency edges with source provenance, traverse them between typed task endpoints, and render them distinctly from parent and Story-ownership edges -- preserving bounded traversal and cycle handling.

Cross-repo note: this needs the Quest-side edge source. opum-agent has already routed that half to quest-cli directly (their own tracker). This task is scoped to Lore's side only: consuming/exporting/traversing/rendering dependency edges once the source is available. Coordinate with quest-cli before implementation rather than guessing the edge shape.

Source: 2026-09-13 proof-graph inspection (Lore 0.6.0, Quest 0.6.0), read-only against production, recorded as OPAG-120 on opum-agent.

acceptanceCriteria.text: lore path between two tasks connected only by a Quest dependency (not parenthood) returns the edge with source provenance, using a PGF-1/PGF-2/PGF-3-shaped fixture
lore export emits a dependencies field for tasks carrying Quest dependency edges
lore graph (or an equivalent combined view) renders dependency edges distinctly from parent and Story-ownership edges
Bounded traversal depth and cycle handling apply to dependency edges the same way they already do for existing path/impact edges
